Method of Attack: Ransomware encrypting victim files with simplistic XOR encryption
Extortion via ransom note demanding payment within 24 hours
Distribution via Psiphon VPN app versions laced with ransomware
Use of local payment processors exchanging.ir and webmoney724.ir
Ransom note in Farsi targeting Iranian users
Low coding quality causing partial encryption failure and loss of functionality after reboot
Discoverer: Lawrence Abrams (Bleeping Computer founder and analyst)
Iran Computer Emergency Response Team Coordination Center (Iran CERTCC)
Attack Vector: Laced versions of Psiphon VPN app
RDP connections with weak credentials (general warning by Iran CERTCC)
